This fangame was hyped up a LOT. But was it worth it? No. The release of the fangame had many problems and felt like it was rushed to be "basically finshed".

This fangame has many problems. You can’t even reset the maps, which create a problem where you cant even enter maps without dying if you got a monster stuck at the entrance, because you couldn’t reset map. Before the revamp, you could hold on to the glass in the watch tower, now you can’t. You could also grab on to people, now you can’t.

This fangame felt like it was VERY rushed because of how buggy, lack of content, and the amount of maps blocked off.

Now, before you go like "oh of course it has bugs it’s a release day" they should have nicely TESTED the game before they  released the fangame and called it a "basically finished" game.

Plus, there are very noticeable bugs in the game.

And, the maps lack monsters. Like the monsters in caves lack a lot of monsters, which is disappointing for a "basically finshed" game. Now, this game does have potential to fix this, but i won’t remove my review. This is because i want people to see the core problems of the games, so that the devs can actually fix them in the future.

The player model itself is pretty great. I like the animations on it and the new player model.

Also, this game is probably code rotted because everything that i said about stuff being there before the revamp, just proves this game has code rot. (also this is NOT a meme it’s been something for a long time)

But, the game overall is a little fun and little scary, but not enough to be called "Golds SPOOKY TERROR".

So devs, if you’re seeing this, PLEASE take note of this and fix the problems in your game. I’m not trying to hate the game or offend the developers. This is just critical feedback of the fangame.

There’s a MASSIVE lack of monsters, caves looks like it only has speedster, multiple maps are blocked off, no cosmetics, can’t reset maps, monsters randomly spawn sometimes, and the reaper is unsurvivable without plasma in time. 

Because of this, im giving it a 3 star, if they fix it tomorrow then I’ll be happy.
